rules.title: Limit on payments at or before start of tenancy
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a lessor or the lessor's agent may not require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than the first month's rent, the last month's rent at the same rate, a security deposit equal to the first month's rent, and the purchase and installation cost of a key and lock. The amended text, which adds agents of the lessor, is effective August 1, 2025.
rules.key_value: first month's rent + last month's rent + security deposit equal to first month's rent + key and lock cost
rules.coverage_text: Lessors and agents of lessors of residential tenancies, as to tenants and prospective tenants
rules.citation: General Law Chapter 186, Section 15B(1)(b), as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55
rules.quoted_span: (b) At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:

rules.title: Security deposit cap
rules.requirement: A security deposit may not exceed the first month's rent, and it must be deposited as required by subsection (3) and the tenant must receive the statement of condition. After the tenancy begins, a lessor may not demand a security deposit above the amount this section allows.
rules.key_value: security deposit equal to the first month's rent
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2)

rules.title: Fee in lieu of security deposit
rules.requirement: The executive office of housing and livable communities may issue regulations allowing an optional fee in lieu of a security deposit. Total fees, alone or combined with any security deposit paid, may not exceed 1 month's rent.
rules.key_value: fees plus security deposit not to exceed 1 month's rent
rules.coverage_text: Lessors and tenants or prospective tenants who agree to a fee in lieu of a security deposit under regulations
rules.quoted_span: provided further, that the sum of fees paid to waive a security deposit and the payment of the security deposit shall not exceed, in total, the amount of 1 month's rent

rules.title: Security deposit statement of condition
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent who accepts a security deposit must give the tenant a separate signed written statement of the condition of the premises, listing existing damage, upon receipt of the deposit or within ten days after the tenancy begins, whichever is later.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property, or their agents, who accept a security deposit
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall, upon receipt of such security deposit, or within ten days after commencement of the tenancy, whichever is later, furnish to such tenant or prospective tenant a separate written statement of the present condition of the premises to be leased or rented.

rules.title: Security deposit held in separate interest-bearing account
rules.requirement: A security deposit must be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank in the commonwealth, protected from the lessor's creditors. The tenant must receive a receipt within thirty days naming the bank, its location, the amount and the account number.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors who receive a security deposit
rules.penalty: Failure to comply entitles the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit; the lessor also forfeits the right to retain any portion of the deposit.
rules.quoted_span: (3) (a) Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.

rules.title: Interest on security deposits
rules.requirement: A lessor who holds a security deposit for one year or longer must pay interest at five per cent per year, or the lesser amount the bank paid, to the tenant at the end of each year of tenancy. If the tenant has not received payment or notice within thirty days after the year ends, the tenant may deduct the interest from the next rent payment.
rules.key_value: five per cent per year, or such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property holding a security deposit for one year or longer
rules.penalty: Tenant may deduct the interest due from the next rent payment.
rules.quoted_span: (b) A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.

rules.title: Return of security deposit within thirty days
rules.requirement: The lessor must return the security deposit or any balance within thirty days after the tenancy ends. Deductions are allowed only for unpaid rent or water charges, certain unpaid real estate tax increases, and reasonable repair costs for tenant-caused damage, documented by a sworn itemized list.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors holding a security deposit under a tenancy-at-will or written lease
rules.exemptions: Reasonable wear and tear may not be deducted; damage listed in the statement of condition may not be deducted unless it was repaired and the new damage is unrelated.
rules.penalty: The lessor forfeits the right to retain any portion of the security deposit, or to counterclaim for damage, if the lessor fails to provide the itemized list or fails to return the deposit within thirty days.
